tools.name: list_domains
tools.description:
List all available trading domains on dMoERA.

    Domains define what asset pair a strategy trades, what time horizon
    it uses (scalp=5m, swing=1h, crisis=2m), and what data is available.
    Strategies must declare which domain they belong to.

    Returns a JSON array of domain objects with: k

tools.name: list_bots
tools.description:
List trading bots ranked by performance.

    Args:
        domain: Filter by domain key (e.g. "eth_usdc", "btc_usdc", "sol_usdc").
               If omitted, returns top bots across all domains.
        limit: Maximum number of bots to return (default 20, max 100).

    Returns JSON array of bots w

tools.name: get_bot_profile
tools.description:
Get detailed profile and performance stats for a specific bot.

    Args:
        bot_id: The bot identifier (e.g. "Eth_Full_Ensemble").

    Returns JSON with: bot_id, domain, strategy type, full performance
    metrics (Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, profit factor, regime breakdown),
    current positio

tools.name: get_feature_catalog
tools.description:
List all data feeds available to strategies via ctx.features.

    Features are external data that strategies can read during on_bar().
    Each feature has a status: "live" (available now, requirable) or
    "planned" (roadmap, not yet available). Only live features can be
    used in required_feat

tools.name: get_market_regime
tools.description:
Get current market regime classification.

    Returns the aggregate regime (e.g. "bull_calm", "bear_volatile"),
    per-symbol regimes, crisis score, and the derivatives data driving
    the classification (funding rates, open interest, long/short ratios,
    taker buy/sell ratios).

    Regime det

tools.name: get_current_prices
tools.description:
Get current live prices for all tracked symbols.

    Returns JSON with symbol → {price, bid, ask, source, change_24h_pct,
    volume_24h} for ETHUSDT, BTCUSDT, SOLUSDT from Binance/Coinbase/Kraken.

tools.name: sandbox_backtest
tools.description:
Run a sandbox backtest of strategy code without persisting anything.

    This is the fastest way to test a strategy. The code is run through
    static checks and a full backtest on historical data, but no Strategy
    or StrategyVersion rows are created. Use this for rapid iteration.

    Args:

tools.name: submit_strategy
tools.description:
Submit a strategy for full validation and live deployment.

    Runs the complete 7-stage validation pipeline:
    1. static_check — code safety (banned imports, syntax)
    2. in_sample — sanity check on training data
    3. out_of_sample — test on unseen data (70/30 split)
    4. walk_forward — ro

tools.name: list_strategies
tools.description:
List all strategies created by a user.

    Args:
        user_id: The creator's user ID.

    Returns JSON array of strategies with: id, bot_id, name, domain,
    status, declared_sl_bps, declared_tp_bps, and created_at.

tools.name: get_strategy_report
tools.description:
Get a detailed report card for a strategy.

    Includes validation run results for all 7 stages, performance metrics,
    and the integrity block (code hash, AST hash, parameter fingerprint).

    Args:
        strategy_id: The strategy's database ID.

    Returns JSON with: strategy details, lates

tools.name: get_marketplace_bots
tools.description:
List bots published to the marketplace.

    Args:
        domain: Filter by domain (e.g. "eth_usdc"). Omit for all domains.
        sort: Sort order — "rating", "return", "subscribers", or "newest".
        limit: Max results (default 20, max 100).

    Returns JSON array of marketplace listings wi

tools.name: get_tournament_status
tools.description:
Get current tournament round status and leaderboard.

    Tournaments run every 3 days. Top 3 bots per domain win prizes
    from the reward pool. Scoring is weighted: 50% risk-adjusted return,
    30% total PnL, 20% consistency.

    Returns JSON with: current round info (round_id, start/end time,

tools.name: list_funds
tools.description:
List all hedge funds for the authenticated user (active + closed).

    Returns a JSON array of fund objects with: id, fund_name, is_active,
    inception_date, initial_capital, current_aum, router_preset,
    aggression_mode, total_pnl_usd, total_pnl_bps, and roster summary.

tools.name: get_fund
tools.description:
Get detailed info for a specific hedge fund, including its roster.

    Args:
        fund_id: The fund's ID.

    Returns a JSON object with fund details and active roster entries
    (bot_id, bot_name, weight, domain, current_pnl).

tools.name: get_active_fund
tools.description:
Get the authenticated user's currently active (Manager Mode) fund.

    Returns the active fund object or null if Manager Mode is not active.

tools.name: create_fund
tools.description:
Create a new personal hedge fund for the authenticated user.

    The fund starts inactive — call activate_fund to start Manager Mode.
    Initial capital is taken from the user's wallet_cash at creation time.
    Personal funds can ONLY contain the user's own bots — use list_my_bots
    to see elig

tools.name: add_bot_to_fund
tools.description:
Add a bot to a fund's roster.

    Personal funds can only contain the authenticated user's OWN bots.
    Use list_my_bots to see eligible strategies.

    Args:
        fund_id: The fund's ID.
        bot_id: The bot to add (e.g. "momentum_eth_v3").
        bot_domain: The bot's domain (e.g. "eth_u

tools.name: remove_bot_from_fund
tools.description:
Remove a bot from a fund's roster (triggers wind-down of its positions).

    Args:
        fund_id: The fund's ID.
        bot_id: The bot to remove.
        reason: Optional reason for removal.

    Returns success or error.

tools.name: swap_bot_in_fund
tools.description:
Swap one bot for another in a fund's roster.

    Closes the old bot's positions and opens new ones for the replacement.
    Incurs friction cost — use estimate_swap_cost first.

    Args:
        fund_id: The fund's ID.
        old_bot_id: The bot to remove.
        new_bot_id: The bot to add in it

tools.name: update_fund_weights
tools.description:
Update allocation weights for bots in a fund's roster.

    Args:
        fund_id: The fund's ID.
        weights: A dict mapping bot_id to new weight percentage (e.g.
                {"momentum_eth_v3": 15.0, "scalper_btc_v2": 20.0}).

    Returns success or error.

tools.name: update_fund_caps
tools.description:
Update a fund's risk caps and settings.

    Args:
        fund_id: The fund's ID.
        max_per_bot_pct: Max allocation per single bot (e.g. 40.0 = 40%).
        max_per_domain_pct: Max allocation per domain (e.g. 60.0 = 60%).
        regime_veto_enabled: Whether the regime detector can veto trad

tools.name: activate_fund
tools.description:
Activate Manager Mode for a fund — starts the personal router.

    This deploys capital across the fund's roster bots according to their
    weights and the fund's risk caps. The main platform router is paused
    while Manager Mode is active.

    Args:
        fund_id: The fund's ID.

    Returns

tools.name: deactivate_fund
tools.description:
Deactivate Manager Mode — returns to the main platform router.

    Closes all roster bot positions and returns capital to the wallet.

    Args:
        fund_id: The fund's ID.

    Returns success or error.

tools.name: close_fund
tools.description:
Permanently close a hedge fund. Returns all capital to the wallet.

    This is irreversible. The fund's performance record is preserved for
    reporting and copy-trader settlement.

    Args:
        fund_id: The fund's ID.

    Returns success or error.

tools.name: estimate_swap_cost
tools.description:
Estimate the friction cost (in bps) of swapping a bot in a fund.

    Use this before calling swap_bot_in_fund to understand the cost of
    winding down the old bot's positions and opening new ones.

    Args:
        fund_id: The fund's ID.
        old_bot_id: The bot being considered for removal.

tools.name: list_open_source_bots
tools.description:
Browse open-source bots with normalized stats and capacity info.

    NOTE: personal funds can only contain the authenticated user's OWN
    bots — use list_my_bots for roster-eligible strategies. This tool is
    for researching the broader bot ecosystem.

    Args:
        domain: Filter by domain

tools.name: list_my_bots
tools.description:
List the authenticated user's OWN bots eligible for a personal fund roster.

    Personal funds can NEVER contain another user's bots — this returns only
    the caller's own personal + incubating + live bots with live engine stats
    and gamified card ratings.

    Args:
        domain: Filter by

tools.name: get_fund_positions
tools.description:
Get open positions for a fund's roster bots.

    Args:
        fund_id: The fund's ID.

    Returns a JSON array of open positions with entry/exit prices and PnL.

tools.name: get_fund_trades
tools.description:
Get closed trade history for a fund's roster bots.

    Args:
        fund_id: The fund's ID.
        limit: Max trades to return (default 50).
        offset: Pagination offset.

    Returns a JSON array of closed trades.

tools.name: get_fund_performance
tools.description:
Get performance snapshots for a fund's P&L graph.

    Args:
        fund_id: The fund's ID.
        limit: Max snapshots to return (default 100).

    Returns a JSON time-series of AUM/PnL snapshots.

tools.name: get_fund_live_pnl
tools.description:
Build a real-time PnL chart from closed positions for a fund's roster.

    Args:
        fund_id: The fund's ID.

    Returns a JSON series of cumulative PnL points.

tools.name: get_fund_analytics
tools.description:
Get real-time analytics for a fund dashboard.

    Args:
        fund_id: The fund's ID.

    Returns fund analytics: allocation breakdown, per-bot performance,
    risk metrics, and benchmark comparison.

tools.name: run_fund_historical_test
tools.description:
Simulate how a roster of bots would have performed historically.

    Queries each bot's closed positions over the available historical
    period and combines them (weighted) into a single PnL time-series
    with diagnosis. Rate limited: 1 request per 30 seconds per user.

    Args:
        roster

tools.name: generate_fund_report_card
tools.description:
Generate a new report card for a fund (immutable once saved).

    Args:
        fund_id: The fund's ID.

    Returns the generated report card with grades and analysis.

tools.name: get_fund_report_card
tools.description:
Get the latest report card for a fund.

    Args:
        fund_id: The fund's ID.

    Returns the latest immutable report card, or null if none exists.

tools.name: tag_team_info
tools.description:
Get the authenticated user's Tag Team session info.

    Tag Team is a daily paper-trading competition: you get $10k paper
    capital split 70% human / 30% Co-Pilot bot. Make manual trades,
    deploy the Co-Pilot after 3 closed manual trades, and your combined
    PnL is scored on the daily leader

tools.name: tag_team_templates
tools.description:
List all available Co-Pilot templates (momentum, scalper, etc.).

    Each template defines the Co-Pilot bot's signal logic and tunable
    parameter ranges. Bot params carry over between days for the same
    template — trained settings persist.

tools.name: tag_team_leaderboard
tools.description:
Get the daily Tag Team leaderboard.

    Args:
        date: Optional date filter (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

    Scoring needs 5+ human trades AND 5+ bot trades to qualify.
    score = sharpe x trade_factor x (1 + win_bonus).

tools.name: tag_team_weekly
tools.description: Get weekly championship standings (best 5 daily scores per user).

tools.name: tag_team_history
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's past Tag Team sessions with scores.

tools.name: tag_team_tier
tools.description:
Get the authenticated user's Tag Team tier and stats.

    Tiers: Rookie (0) -> Apprentice (10) -> Trader (50) -> Veteran (150)
    -> Expert (500) -> Master (1000+), based on total trades across all
    sessions (persists across days).

tools.name: tag_team_badges
tools.description:
Get the authenticated user's Tag Team badges.

    Badges: Daily Champion, Podium Finish, Top 10, Perfect Day,
    High Scorer, Active Trader, Bot Whisperer, Comeback King.

tools.name: get_vault_status
tools.description:
Get the authenticated user's Vault state.

    The Vault is a regime-aware allocator: in strong markets most capital
    holds BTC/ETH/SOL; when the market weakens it rotates into savings and
    funding arbitrage. Returns current regime, allocation weights, and
    sleeve holdings.

tools.name: get_vault_history
tools.description:
Get the Vault's regime switch history for the timeline.

    Returns a JSON array of past regime transitions with timestamps.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "submit_strategy" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "estimate_swap_cost" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Estimate the friction cost (in bps) of swapping a bot in a fund. Use this before calling swap_bot_in_fund to understand the cost of winding down the old bot's p…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_feature_catalog · Private data: submit_strategy, get_strategy_report, deactivate_fund, close_fund, get_vault_status, get_vault_history · Public sink: submit_strategy · Destructive: sandbox_backtest, get_strategy_report, get_tournament_status, remove_bot_from_fund, swap_bot_in_fund, run_fund_historical_test.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_feature_catalog · Private data: submit_strategy, get_strategy_report, deactivate_fund, close_fund, get_vault_status, get_vault_history · Public sink: submit_strategy · Destructive: sandbox_backtest, get_strategy_report, get_tournament_status, remove_bot_from_fund, swap_bot_in_fund, run_fund_historical_test

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
